independentInstitutionalContext.finding: Navy reports August 4 approval to establish UAPTF and its operational threat-assessment mission.
Archive records identify problems with the Cutler-Twining MJ-12 memo; search did not substantiate programme; holding/certification does not authenticate contents.
Agencies reported no evidence the examined MJ-12 materials originated as genuine executive-branch documents; a different 1980 message containing 'MJ Twelve' was assessed as a forgery.
FBI catalog says two offices received versions of alleged MJ-12 memo in 1988 and that an Air Force investigation found the document fake.
